en.bdb: Desire from the earning of the religious place -

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਸ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ।
verses.translit_en: kharaa dhuhelaa jag vich jis a(n)dhar jhaaku|

en.bdb: He is ever sorrowful who has craving in his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨੇ ਨੋ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਹੁਇ ਵੰਞੈ ਖਾਕੁ।
verses.translit_en: soine no hath paidhaa hui va(n)n(j)ai khaaku|

en.bdb: He touches the gold and that turns into the lump of soil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਠ ਮਿਤ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਵਿਹਰਨਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਕੁ।
verses.translit_en: eiTh mit put bhairaa viharan sabh saaku|

en.bdb: Dear friends, sons, brothers, and all other relatives become unhappy with him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ।
verses.translit_en: sog vijog saraap hai dhuramat naapaaku|

en.bdb: Such evil-minded person ever suffers the curse of meeting and separation i.e. he undergoes the sufferings of transmigration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਤੈ ਮੁਤੜਿ ਰੰਨ ਜਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਲਾਕੁ।
verses.translit_en: vatai mutaR ra(n)n jiau dhar milai talaaku|

en.bdb: He wanders like an abandoned woman and stands divorced from the door (of the Lod).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਭੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਘਣਾ ਦੋਜਕ ਅਉਤਾਕੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: dhukh bhukh dhaalidh ghanaa dhojak aautaak ||13||

en.bdb: He gets distress, hunger, profuse poverty and reaches hell after the (bodily) death.
